messages:
Harper Nguyen: quick post-launch pulse. we have 2 customer-facing regressions (billing double charge, signup intermittent 504) + ~13 low-urgency bugs and 4 feature asks from pilots. decision: do we run a 4-day ‘stabilize’ sprint or keep a rolling mix?
Omar Velazquez: leaning stabilize. concentrated fixes reduce flak and lower on-call noise. propose Mon-Thu stabilization, Fri for a single gated ship if all gates pass.
Sana Patel: product POV  agree stabilize-first. but allow a single micro-invest ticket behind a flag if it has clear churn impact and <3 dev-days. need acceptance criteria before it lands.
Drew Kim: ops note  signup 504 looks like connection pooling under spike; i can land a conservative pool-size bump + extra telemetry in a single PR with a 1hr canary. billing dup needs db idempotency check. both high priority.
Harper Nguyen: proposed gates to close the stabilize sprint: 1) zero open P0s; 2) smoke tests green; 3) p99 latency <= baseline *1.10; 4) no feature rolled to >5% without feature flag + telemetry.
Omar Velazquez: rollout checklist for hotfixes:
```
- create 5% canary cohort
- run smoke + perf suite
- watch error-rate and p99
- rollback if error-rate > baseline*2 or p99 > baseline*1.15
```
Sana Patel: enhancement gating template (short): 1) customer problem statement, 2) acceptance metric, 3) telemetry events, 4) rollback plan, 5) owner. will post a one-pager.
Drew Kim: owners suggestion: Drew -> signup pool patch + canary; Omar -> billing idempotency fix + verification; Harper -> comms + prioritize backlog. I'll schedule canary window Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Harper Nguyen: action items: Sana -> post gating template + score the 4 asks by EOD; Omar & Drew -> land hotfix PRs and prepare runbooks; I'll create sprint board and assign hotfix lane owner.
NotifyBot: Meeting scheduled: "Stabilize sprint kickoff" tomorrow 09:30 AM PT.
Omar Velazquez: small operational note  reserve one QA slot for hotfix verification and one engineer for on-call during ship. aim for minimal blast radius.
Sana Patel: i'll score the pilot asks now; early signal: CSV export and export-on-webhook look like low-effort, high-impact candidates. context-length bump is big and stays backlog.
Harper Nguyen: agreement: CSV export -> candidate for Fri micro-ship if gates pass. otherwise we keep focus on fixes. short updates in-thread please. will finalize plan in kickoff. :thumbsup:
